claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Liberty 或 Caterpillar 之後的 10-Q／10-K／新聞稿寫出資料中心燃氣機組訂單取消、延後超過一年，或停止供應這一類機組；或買方的一手寫出改用別家機組取代它。核查頻率：每季（Liberty 或 Caterpillar 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀 tech:gas_reciprocating_genset 供給側（本層讀圖寫成後）。
claims.statement: Buyer-side filing (Liberty 10-Q Q3 2026 Exhibit 10.2): G20CM34 Supply Agreement with Caterpillar Inc. for Cat G20CM34 engines rated on pipeline natural gas, total contract price USD 801,000,000. The contract defines a Generator Set as engine, alternator, mechanical coupling and base-frame, and says the Unit Base Price does not include balance of plant, equipment integration or generator set package assembly — so Caterpillar's scope here is centred on the engine; who assembles the genset package is not stated in this document. The edge is drawn at the genset layer as a modelling choice.

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報（10-Q Exhibit 10.2，部分內容已遮蔽）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取 EDGAR 申報日 2026-10-22。

sources.quote: This G20CM34 Supply Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is entered into by and between Caterpillar Inc.
Measured power is expected to be [***] bkW using pipeline natural gas with a Cat Methane Number of 75 or higher.
The total price for all Goods and services under this Agreement shall be $801,000,000 (the “ Contract Price ”).
“ Generator Set ” or “ Genset ” shall mean the unit consisting of the assembly of an Engine, alternator, mechanical coupling, and base-frame(s).
